insights.one_liner: Dutch arm of Canadian IT and business consultancy CGI, about 1,436 people based in Rotterdam; an IND sponsor.

culture.text: Large consultancy: about 1,436 staff in the Netherlands, headquartered in Rotterdam; CGI was founded in 1976.
Staff often come from The Hague, Rotterdam and Amsterdam universities of applied sciences, TU Delft and Groningen, mostly in IT and computer science.
Its company texts are in Dutch, and the work is mainly engineering, consulting and project management.

open.text: CGI Nederland B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Owned by CGI Inc. in Canada, which operates from 400 locations worldwide.
